REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - MAY 23, 2024 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made during regular business hours by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 6.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and the document(s) will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.us in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

9A.  Review and consideration by the City Council of the City of Cerritos of potential locations
  for the installation of pickleball courts at City-owned park facilities in the eastern portion of
  the City and update on construction of pickleball courts at Liberty Park (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Sherré Titus, Recreation Services Superintendent. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Jay Mehta commented on the benefits of pickleball and expressed support for Cerritos Park
  East and Heritage Park as locations for additional pickleball courts. He inquired whether the
  Cerritos Park East handball courts and spray pool could be converted into pickleball courts.

  Sam Desai expressed support for Cerritos Park East and Heritage Park as locations for
  additional pickleball courts.

  Teddy Lloyd expressed support for new pickleball courts rather than repurposed courts.

  Mel Cortez expressed opposition to repurposing the Cerritos Park East spray pool or
  removing items designated for children and expressed support for placing a pickleball court
  on the center field of the Cerritos Park East track.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Barrows, to defer action on this item
  until after receiving recommendations from the Aquatic Design Group consultant, including
  options for renovating the Cerritos Park East spray pool and further consideration of
  placement of a new pickleball court, inclusive of a potential location at Cerritos Park East in
  the grass area north of the main playground (COUNCIL).
